title: Retain both the convex-minors separation and the positive buffer
statement: For every independently varying full35 perturbation |g_i|<=rho=1/84000000, F*+(1/100000)T²+G is accepted strongly QC with weighted modulus 1/800000 and non-PC. The two support cuts exclude an arbitrary convex minors lift, not only polynomial/SOS lifts; their robust rational gap exceeds 3/100. Hessian bound 1680rho*T and convex H=G+420rho*T² preserve the same angular correction. The explicit box is not identified with the old unevaluated origin-regular exclusion neighborhood.
